objective: Cross-check candidate types, index arithmetic, and padding handling for coherence.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the index arithmetic.
pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate uses representable i32 addition, mathematical floor-modulo for both axes, exact f32 loads/stores, and restricts reads/writes to logical width-by-height cells.
setup: Inspect the candidate shift addition, floor-modulo computation, row stride usage, and logical bounds; verify no C remainder (%) is used for negative values and no padded source column is read.
